name: ingeniero-agentico
description: Industrial engineering methods as agent skills: procurement, cost and pricing, economic and financial evaluation, plus orchestrate, map-context, research and audit. Every number comes from a script with a test that must match; the company's data lives outside the plugin. Guides in English and Spanish.

python.title: Python command
python.description: What launches the MCP server: python (Windows with Python on the PATH), py (Windows launcher), python3 (macOS and Linux) or the absolute path to the executable. Python 3.11 or newer, with openpyxl.

data.title: Data folder (optional)
data.description: Absolute path to ingeniero-agentico-datos (the one with profiles/ and cases/). Empty: the server uses INGENIERO_DATOS or the temp folder.

roots.title: Extra folders the server can read and write (optional)
roots.description: Absolute paths separated by ; on Windows or : on macOS and Linux (the folders of a task you want to map). Empty: only the repo, the data folder and the work folder.
